label: Transportation
assignment: Discover realistic transportation resources for people in {service_area} who cannot reliably reach work, health care, food, benefits, education, or other essential services. Follow transit agencies and coordinating organizations to specific fixed-route, paratransit, medical, voucher, volunteer-driver, vehicle, bicycle, and emergency-ride programs. Verify trip purpose, eligibility, coverage, hours, fare, reservation, accessibility, and pickup reliability.
include: Fixed-route transit, reduced fares, passes, route planning, and first-mile or last-mile links
ADA paratransit, senior, disability, and door-to-door transportation
Non-emergency medical transport, Medicaid rides, hospital and treatment transportation
Ride vouchers, volunteer drivers, employment rides, vehicle repair, donated vehicles, bicycles, and licenses
Rural coverage, advance reservations, companions, mobility devices, language, and urgent-trip realities
exclude: Ordinary taxi or rideshare options without a subsidy or accessible hardship pathway
Transit information that does not establish whether the needed origin, destination, and time are served
Vehicle donation pages that solicit vehicles but do not place transportation with clients

sourceChannels: official transit, city, county, and Medicaid transportation pages
operating nonprofit and senior-service program pages
hospital, treatment, workforce, and disability transportation programs
vehicle-placement, repair, and bicycle programs with client eligibility

focuses.label: Fixed-route transit and fare access
focuses.direction: Find practical fixed-route, reduced-fare, pass, route-planning, and first-mile or last-mile help for people with limited income.

focuses.label: Paratransit, senior, and disability rides
focuses.direction: Find ADA paratransit and other door-to-door services, verifying certification, geography, reservations, fares, companions, and mobility-device rules.

focuses.label: Medical and treatment transportation
focuses.direction: Find Medicaid and non-Medicaid rides to medical, dental, behavioral-health, dialysis, cancer, and recovery services with real scheduling instructions.

focuses.label: Employment, essential-trip, and emergency rides
focuses.direction: Find direct ride vouchers or programs for work, education, benefits, food, crisis relocation, or other essential trips not covered by medical transportation.

focuses.label: Vehicles, repairs, bicycles, and licensing
focuses.direction: Find programs that directly place reliable vehicles or bicycles, subsidize repairs, or resolve licensing barriers; exclude donation solicitation without client placement.
